Definition: from G1756; to be active, efficient:--do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in).
BiblicalUsage: To work, to be active and effectual. The same God works all in all in 1 Corinthians 12:6, His word effectually works in those who believe in 1 Thessalonians 2:13, and the mystery of iniquity already works in 2 Thessalonians 2:7. Paul says affliction itself is effectual in the enduring of suffering in 2 Corinthians 1:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's working is never idle — His word works in believers, His Spirit works through suffering, and even the mystery of evil works only until He removes the restraint. I hold that my job is not to make God work but to get out of the way of the work He is already doing.
RelatedTopics: God's Power; Spiritual gifts; Word of God
